message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, does “review” sound like her deliberate choice of language or an accidental shift, and what in the dialogue supports your reading? What would further thought clarify that an English revision would not, and what unresolved uncertainty could make revising premature? What textual difference would justify your choice? Could you briefly identify what you found, what remains uncertain, and your next intention in English, then carry out the step you choose?
speaker: Astra
